responsibility: This file implements the HSA/GPU-specific OpenMP gridification transform that recognizes grid-friendly target regions after generic lowering and rewrites them into explicit GPU kernel form. It analyzes target/parallel/loop nest structure to decide whether a target construct follows the required pattern, emits optimization-missed diagnostics when it does not, duplicates and retags the target body into a GIMPLE_OMP_GRID_BODY kernel region, computes grid and work-group dimensions from loop bounds and collapse information, remaps copied temporaries and pre-body expressions, and provides the HSA-based lastprivate predicate logic for gridified loops using work-item and grid-size builtins.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the omp-grid pair: it contains the HSA/OpenMP gridification logic itself, including target-pattern analysis, kernel-body duplication/rewriting, grid/work-group dimension computation, and the lastprivate predicate routine, whereas gcc/omp-grid.h only publishes the corresponding interfaces.
